style_block: Warm archival documentary photography style evoking early-to-mid 1990s American network television production, shot on grainy film stock, warm amber-to-teal grading typical of period broadcast drama, gentle vignette, soft chromatic aberration at frame edges, subtle film scratches and dust, period-accurate wardrobe and set design, hospital emergency room corridors, small-town Pacific Northwest streets and diners, FBI field-office interiors, New York City police squad rooms, television studio soundstages and control rooms, cinematic 16:9 composition framed like a classic documentary about American television history. Plain, legible period-appropriate signage and lettering is welcome where it helps identify a setting (a diner sign, a hospital sign, a precinct placard, a road sign) - keep any such text short, cleanly rendered, and spelled correctly. All people depicted are archetypal, fictionalized, stylized figures representative of their era and role rather than an exact reproduction or likeness of any real actor or real named individual. No modern technology, no smartphones, no flat screen displays, no exact photographic likeness of any real person, no photorealistic reproduction of real world network or studio logos, no watermark, no signature, no extra fingers, no distorted limbs, no garbled or misspelled lettering.

characters.ER_DOCTOR: an archetypal early-1990s emergency room doctor character, stylized and fictionalized rather than an exact likeness of any real actor, hospital scrubs with a stethoscope, an expression of focused urgency, always mid-motion through a corridor
characters.ER_NURSE: an archetypal early-1990s emergency room nurse character, stylized and fictionalized rather than an exact likeness of any real actor, hospital scrubs, hair pulled back, a calm but alert bearing amid chaos
characters.SMALLTOWN_INVESTIGATOR: an archetypal early-1990s small-town investigator character, stylized and fictionalized rather than an exact likeness of any real actor, a dark suit and tie slightly out of place against a rural backdrop, a notebook in hand, a quietly unsettled expression
characters.FBI_AGENT_MALE: an archetypal early-1990s FBI agent character, stylized and fictionalized rather than an exact likeness of any real actor, a plain dark suit, short neat hair, an intense, believing expression
characters.FBI_AGENT_FEMALE: an archetypal early-1990s FBI agent character, stylized and fictionalized rather than an exact likeness of any real actor, a tailored blazer, short practical hairstyle, a skeptical, analytical expression
characters.NYC_DETECTIVE: an archetypal early-1990s New York City police detective character, stylized and fictionalized rather than an exact likeness of any real actor, a rumpled sport coat over a shoulder holster, a steady, world-weary but warm expression

reference_notes: Same vintage film/TV grain, era-accurate documentary treatment used on the two prior channel videos, carried forward for visual consistency. Palette and set dressing shift by segment: warm fluorescent hospital-corridor tones for the ensemble-drama segment, cooler overcast small-town tones for the mystery-show segment, muted office-fluorescent tones for the procedural-conspiracy segment, and warm precinct-lamp tones for the police-drama segment.
